title: "R Primers for Geoscientists"
toc: false
---

Interactive tutorials that teach the basics of R. The code runs in your browser, so there is nothing to install.

## Before Week 1

Work through these two tutorials, in order. Together they take two to three hours.

1. [**Programming basics**](basics/02-programming-basics/index.qmd): functions, arguments, objects, vectors and types. The last two parts, on lists and packages, are optional.
2. [**Working with data**](basics/03-working-with-data/index.qmd): loading a CSV file, inspecting it, summarising and plotting it, and writing your own functions.

Everything else on this site is **optional**. It covers {ggplot2} and {dplyr}, which the course teaches from Week 2, so it's useful for a head start or a refresher.

These tutorials support the [Research Skills for Geoscientists](https://geol-skills.github.io/) course at Durham University. See the course's [preparation guide](https://geol-skills.github.io/materials/preparation.html) for the rest of what to do before term starts.
